user_saw: With partial streaming, the final Telegram answer could appear unthreaded or reply to the wrong message despite an explicit reply tag.
summary: Telegram now sends a replacement final and removes the preview after delivery when the resolved reply target differs from the preview’s actual target.
reasoning: PR #146361 added a comparison against the pre-recovery payload, which accepts an explicit target already present in that payload. Its parent and the July 1 snapshot already allowed text finals to reuse previews without checking the final target against the preview’s target. The available offline history stops at the shallow boundary, so I could not verify which commit introduced the mismatch or whether an earlier implementation handled it correctly.
